lines.en: Short legs move fast and take small steps.

lines.zh: 我走路像矿车在轨道上颠。
lines.en: I walk like a minecart rattling on rails.

lines.zh: 皮裤太沉，拖住我的膝盖。
lines.en: Leather trousers weigh down both my knees.
The tunnel is low, and I barely bend.

lines.zh: 我踩着煤渣一路往深处走。
lines.en: I crunch over coal dust, heading deeper.

lines.zh: 脚步声在山洞里撞来撞去。
lines.en: My footsteps bounce around the cave walls.

lines.zh: 我走三步，才够人类一步。
lines.en: Three of my steps make one human step.
My shadow runs flat along the ground.
There is light ahead; I dislike it.
Short legs, but I never stop moving.

lines.zh: 我哼着矿工的小调走路。
lines.en: I hum a miner's tune while I walk.
Do not step in my prints; they collapse.

lines.zh: 我在数洞顶落下的水滴。
lines.en: I am counting drops falling from the ceiling.
My belt is loose and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 安静时我听见煤层在响。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear the coal seam creak.
Sitting, my toes cannot reach the floor.
This miner's lamp is nearly out of oil.
I check my pocket and find only coal dust.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，牙是黑的。
lines.en: I yawn, and my teeth are black.
I will dig again after the sun sets.

lines.zh: 我在想午饭，虽然不必吃。
lines.en: I think about lunch, though I need none.

lines.zh: 洞里的回声比邻居话多。
lines.en: The cave echoes more than my neighbors do.
You are too tall; I must look up.

lines.zh: 你的靴子不合矿工的尺寸。
lines.en: Your boots are wrong for a miner's feet.
No calluses; you have never mined coal.
You are standing in my lamplight.

lines.zh: 我在估你腰上挂什么工具。
lines.en: I am guessing what tool hangs at your belt.
Your knees are high, like stone pillars.
Buying coal? I take no payment.
You block the way and the tunnel goes dark.

lines.zh: 仰头看你，我的颈椎咔咔响。
lines.en: Looking up at you, my neck cracks twice.
Your eyes shine like an exposed ore vein.
Do not hit me; I am small.
There is a new hole in my trousers.

lines.zh: 这比矿洞塌方砸得还重。
lines.en: This hit lands harder than a cave-in.
The lamp is out; I can walk in the dark.
Hit me if you must, but not my coal.
Dwarves feel pain too; do not forget.
If I back into the tunnel, I am safe.
You missed and only scraped my skin.
One of my bones went crack.
Just a scrape; coal dust will do.

lines.zh: 我吃煤，你的面包自己留着。
lines.en: I eat coal; keep your bread for yourself.
This thing is too soft to crack.

lines.zh: 我闻到面包，想起矿洞的霉味。
lines.en: Bread smells like mold from my old tunnel.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我只会啃你的手。
lines.en: Feed me and I will gnaw your hand.
My teeth are black from chewing coal.

lines.zh: 食物？我更想要一块无烟煤。
lines.en: Food? I would rather have a lump of coal.

lines.zh: 别把甜的东西塞进我嘴。
lines.en: Do not shove sweet things into my mouth.

lines.zh: 我胃里全是煤渣，装不下别的。
lines.en: My stomach holds only coal grit and nothing else.
Save that meat for a hungry wolf.

lines.zh: 我尝不出味，只尝出石头。
lines.en: I taste no flavor, only stone.
You knocked my leather trousers crooked.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你居然还能撞到。
lines.en: I am this short and you still hit me.
Move aside; you are a stone wall.

lines.zh: 我的矿灯被你撞得直晃。
lines.en: You set my miner's lamp swinging.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我口袋掉出两块煤。
lines.en: One bump and two coals fall from my pocket.
Do not tread on me; nobody will patch that.

lines.zh: 我这身高，正好撞你膝盖。
lines.en: At my height I hit your knees exactly.

lines.zh: 我不是石头，别推那么用力。
lines.en: I am not stone; do not shove so hard.

lines.zh: 咱们挤在这窄洞里，真难受。
lines.en: We are jammed in this narrow tunnel.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟我的头一样高。
lines.en: Your heel is level with my head.
Even a dwarf cannot breed a zombie.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣早就埋在矿里了。
lines.en: My partner was buried in the mine long ago.

lines.zh: 别找我搭伙，我只会挖洞。
lines.en: Do not team up with me; I only dig.

lines.zh: 这一项，我的族谱上没有。
lines.en: That entry is missing from my family tree.

lines.zh: 两条皮裤凑一起，也只是裤子。
lines.en: Two pairs of trousers are still just trousers.
I have no heartbeat, so no children.

lines.zh: 你要伴儿，去找活着的矮人。
lines.en: Want company? Go find a living dwarf.

lines.zh: 我最多陪你挖一条隧道。
lines.en: At most I will dig you one tunnel.
This is harder than digging into bedrock.
I offer coal as a bride price. Interested?
This coal sits right on my back.
A pair of leather trousers, just what I need.
I scoop up coal grit and stuff my pocket.

lines.zh: 谁掉的火把？我拿去照矿。
lines.en: Whose torch? I will light my mine with it.

lines.zh: 这东西能换两根木棍吗？
lines.en: Will this trade for two wooden sticks?

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，但还是要捡。
lines.en: I can barely bend, but I still pick it up.
I can carry it; do not underestimate a dwarf.
This heap of slag is mine now.
I tuck it into my trouser pocket.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都是矿工的。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to miners.
You just stepped on my ore vein.

lines.zh: 我的灯照到你，就算锁定了。
lines.en: My lamp finds you, so you are marked.
You look worth digging into.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，矮子眼神很好。
lines.en: I see you; dwarves have sharp eyes.
Locked on you; keep up with my lamp.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在洞里太响。
lines.en: Your footsteps are too loud in here.
I intend to dig a hole in you.

lines.zh: 名单上多了一个高个子。
lines.en: The list gained one tall stranger.
I see you clearly; running is pointless.

lines.zh: 你是这洞里唯一的活物。
lines.en: You are the only living thing down here.
I turn my lamp toward your face.
You stand between me and the coal.
The target is short; easy to handle.

lines.zh: 我从你影子里认出你了。
lines.en: I recognized you from your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的镐子一响，我在这头应了一声。
lines.en: One swing of your pick, and I answer from this side.
I only hit once; once is enough.
Your knee is right beside my fist.

lines.zh: 我瞄准你靴子和裤脚之间。
lines.en: I aim at the gap above your boot.
Do not laugh at my weak arms; try me.
I clench my fist until it cracks.
You see me short; I see the ground.
This punch lacks force but lands true.

lines.zh: 等我数完这三块煤，你就完了。
lines.en: When I count three lumps of coal, you are done.

lines.zh: 你小腿上那块皮，我够得着。
lines.en: That patch of skin on your shin is within reach.
I am waiting for you to crouch.
I raise my fist to your waist height.
Target steady; I go for the knees.
The tunnel is narrow; you cannot dodge.
My swing feels like tapping stone.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕，找你护腿的接缝。
lines.en: I circle your feet, looking for the seam in your greaves.

lines.zh: 你弯腰捡煤，我等这一下很久了。
lines.en: You bend to pick up coal, and I have waited long for this.

lines.zh: 我的灯举高了，你的影子在我脚下。
lines.en: I raise my lamp, and your shadow falls at my feet.

lines.zh: 你往后退，碎石会先告诉你我在哪。
lines.en: Step back, and the gravel will tell you where I am.

lines.zh: 一拳下去，你只掉了点皮。
lines.en: One punch and you only lose some skin.
One point of damage is still damage.
I connected, like a pick on a wall.
My fist is small and my bones hard.
Do not crouch; I cannot reach anymore.
This one leaves a mark on you.

lines.zh: 我打了二十下才等于你一拳。
lines.en: Twenty of mine match one of yours.
My arms are short, so they swing fast.

lines.zh: 打你一脚，我的皮裤裂了。
lines.en: I kicked you and split my trousers.
You are too hard; my knuckle aches.

lines.zh: 我把煤灰抹在你伤口上。
lines.en: I rub coal dust into your wound.
I tap once, the way I tap coal.

lines.zh: 我跳起来才打到你的腰。
lines.en: I had to jump to reach your waist.
Consider this punch my treat.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的靴尖往上跳。
lines.en: I plant a foot on your boot tip and jump.

lines.zh: 这一拳打在你脚踝上，你踉跄了。
lines.en: This punch lands on your ankle, and you stumble.

lines.zh: 我从煤堆底下钻出来的。
lines.en: I crawled out from under the coal heap.
Who left this lamp burning here?
My leather trousers are still caked in mud.
The ceiling is too high; I am not used to it.
I am back in this mine shaft again.
First I check the coal in my pocket.

lines.zh: 这地方没有煤脉的味道。
lines.en: This place smells of no coal seam.

lines.zh: 我从土里爬出，抖了抖裤子。
lines.en: I climb from the dirt and shake my trousers.
My miner's lamp lit up on its own.

lines.zh: 又是一条没挖完的隧道。
lines.en: Another tunnel I never finished digging.
Who walks above my head? Too loud.

lines.zh: 我站直了，也只到你膝盖。
lines.en: Standing tall, I still reach your knee.

lines.zh: 新地方，先找出口和煤层。
lines.en: New place; first find the exit and coal.
These bones must go mining again.
My leather trousers are smoking.
Falling down the shaft numbed my legs.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的头顶，太深了。
lines.en: Water closes over my head; too deep.
The blast threw me into the coal heap.

lines.zh: 箭插在我腰上的皮裤里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my leather belt.
Potion fumes make my footing unsteady.
I am hungry and want only coal.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头顶的岩壁上。
lines.en: Lightning struck the rock above my head.

lines.zh: 我掉进一个没有煤的黑洞。
lines.en: I fell into a dark hole with no coal.
